newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan overnight rate 0.72%, highest since Sept 95.
newsitem.headline: Japan overnight rate 0.72%, highest since Sept 95.

text.p: The weighted average of Japan's key overnight call rate was 0.72 percent on Monday, the highest level since the Bank of Japan's (BOJ) last rate cut on September 8, 1995, traders said.
Friday's weighted average rate was 0.51 percent.
The key overnight rate briefly rose as high as 0.85 percent in early afternoon before falling down quickly as fund demand withered toward the day's close.

Despite the BOJ's more accommodative operation than expected at 0020 GMT and an additional fund supply at 0222 GMT, banks' seasonal demands on the last day of the 1995/96 business year kept the key rate from falling sharply, traders said.
Some said the rate was boosted by some banks which were in great need of overnight money after failing to raise enough long-term funds covering the fiscal year-end.
